Computing + AI for All.

A collaboration between university researchers and K–12 educators expanding access to meaningful computing, computational thinking, and AI learning.

Visit Computing + AI for All →All projects

About the project

Computing education built for more learners.

Computing + AI for All works with educators to make computing and AI learning relevant, accessible, and connected to students’ communities.

The project combines curriculum development, teacher learning, and research. Its work emphasizes creative problem solving and computational thinking, with particular attention to multilingual learners and students who have historically had fewer opportunities in computing.

LearnersK–12 students
FocusComputing, computational thinking, and AI
ApproachResearch-practice partnership with educators

Project priorities

Understand, create, and participate.

Build Computational Thinking

Students develop ways to decompose problems, recognize patterns, and design solutions.

Explore AI

Learning experiences help students understand what AI can do, how it works, and where judgment matters.

Center Equity

Curriculum and teacher support are designed to broaden participation and value students’ languages and experiences.
